node.statement: Algebra for the weighted inequality: write h_j=h(p_j), J_+={j:P_vj>0}, and J_-={j:P_vj<0}. From 0=sum_j P_vj h_j, moving negative terms gives sum_{j in J_+} P_vj h_j=sum_{j in J_-} (-P_vj) h_j. Since w_f=max(P_vf,0), F-positive terms are a sub-sum of the nonnegative left side, so sum_{f in F} w_f h_f <= sum_{j in J_+} P_vj h_j. Since 0<=h_j<=1, the right side equals sum_{j in J_-} (-P_vj)h_j <= sum_{j in J_-} (-P_vj)=sum_j max(-P_vj,0)=nu_v by def-negative-mass.
